title: Implement OpenAI-compatible provider adapter
description:
Create chatbot/providers/openai_compat.py implementing the Provider interface for OpenAI-compatible APIs.

This adapter serves OpenRouter, local vLLM, and Vast.ai-stood-up instances: base_url and api_key differ, but the contract is identical. Use the openai Python client or httpx to send chat completions requests.

The adapter must:
- Accept base_url, api_key, and default_model configuration.
- Implement complete() returning a ProviderResponse (from base.py).
- Translate ProviderConfig into the OpenAI-compatible request shape.
- Map OpenAI response fields (choices[0].message.content, finish_reason) into ProviderResponse.
- Handle HTTP errors by raising the appropriate ProviderError subclass from base.py.
- Validate that model strings are non-empty before execution.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- docs/operations.md
- chatbot/providers/base.py (the Provider interface you must implement)
- backends/base.py (async execute and error handling patterns)

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY chatbot/providers/openai_compat.py. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, or any code outside the listed path. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.
acceptance_criteria: No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified

allowed: use openai Python client or httpx for HTTP calls
implement async complete() per Provider ABC
map OpenAI response fields to ProviderResponse
forbidden: add provider registry logic (that belongs in base.py)
add routing or fallback logic (that belongs in router.py)
